author: nickyeow

english.text: Even though he has turned twenty, he's still too timid to chat with girls.

jyutping: keoi5 dou1 jaa6 seoi3 laa3，daan6 hai6 dou1 zung6 hai6 m4 gau3 daam2 tung4 neoi5 zai2 king1 gai3。
text: 佢都廿歲喇，但係都仲係唔夠膽同女仔傾計。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What do you say to taking a rest?

jyutping: bat1 jyu4 tau2 haa2 sin1 laa1？
text: 不如唞吓先啦？

author: nickyeow

english.text: How come you say nothing?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 m4 ceot1 seng1 aa3？
text: 你做咩唔出聲呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He was fined 10000 yen.

jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 fat6 zo2 jat1 maan6 jyun4。
text: 佢俾人罰咗一萬円。

author: nickyeow

english.text: For one thing, I've no money, and for another, I've no leisure.

jyutping: dai6 jat1，ngo5 mou5 cin4，dai6 ji6，ngo5 mou5 hung1 haan4 si4 gaan1。
text: 第一，我冇錢，第二，我冇空閒時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He said to me, 'Let's eat out tonight.'

jyutping: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 waa6：「gam1 maan1 bat1 jyu4 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 aa1。」
text: 佢同我講話：「今晚不如出去食吖。」

author: kaenif

english.text: Can I have a look at the magazine?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tai2 haa5 bun2 zaap6 zi3 aa3？
text: 我可唔可以睇吓本雜誌呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2？
text: 點解？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please remind me to mail the report tomorrow.

jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 gei3 zyu6 tai4 ngo5 gei3 fan6 bou3 gou3 ceot1 heoi3 wo3。
text: 你聽日記住提我寄份報告出去喎。

author: fercheung

english.text: I'm washing the dishes.

jyutping: ngo5 sai2 gan2 wun2 ji4 gaa1。
text: 我洗緊碗而家。

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom turned out to be a thief.

jyutping: jyun4 loi4 aa3 Tom hai2 caak6 lai4 ge3。
text: 原來阿Tom喺賊嚟嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: I have to introduce Mary to the manager.

jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 gaai3 siu6 aa3 Mary bei2 ging1 lei5 sik1。
text: 我要介紹阿Mary俾經理識。

author: kaenif

english.text: Who is standing there?

jyutping: kei5 hai2 dou6 go2 go3 bin1 go3 lai4？
text: 企喺度嗰個邊個嚟？

author: kaenif

english.text: Stop playing video games. You're addicted.

jyutping: m4 hou2 daa2 gei1 laa3，nei5 soeng5 jan5 laa3。
text: 唔好打機喇，你上癮喇。

author: kaenif

english.text: I can't get over how different the weather is here.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gwaan3 ni1 dou6 di1 tin1 hei3，taai3 m4 tung4 laa3。
text: 我唔慣呢度啲天氣，太唔同喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We'll try to stop by sometime tomorrow morning.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeon6 loeng6 ting1 ziu1 lai4 laa1。
text: 我哋盡量聽朝嚟啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Even plastic surgery won't do anything for your ugliness.

jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 seoi1，zing2 jung4 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你咁樣衰，整容都冇用㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You might as well go kill yourself.

jyutping: nei5 bat1 jyu4 sei2 zo2 heoi3 syun3 laa1。
text: 你不如死咗去算啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I cleaned the windows in the spring but they're dirty again.

jyutping: ngo5 ceon1 tin1 go2 zan6 maat3 gon1 zeng6 zo2 di1 coeng1，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jau6 wu1 cou4 faan1 laa3。
text: 我春天嗰陣抹乾淨咗啲窗，但係佢哋而家又污漕返喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We don't know what we're up against.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 deoi3 sau2 hai6 bin1 go3。
text: 我哋唔知我哋嘅對手係邊個。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you two really dating again?

jyutping: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 hai2 faan2 maai4 jat1 cai4 naa4？
text: 你哋兩個真係喺返埋一齊嗱？

author: nickyeow

english.text: We've been without power for three days now.

jyutping: ting4 zo2 din6 saam1 jat6 laa3。
text: 停咗電三日喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How would you feel if someone did that to you?

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ne1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 hai2 nei5 san1 soeng6，nei5 wui5 jau5 me1 gam2 gok3 aa1？
text: 如果呢件事發生喺你身上，你會有咩感覺吖？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom has a strong sense of responsibility.

jyutping: aa3 Tom hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gam2。
text: 阿Tom好有責任感。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Some individuals get offended at the suggestion that their native language might have foreign influences.

jyutping: jau5 di1 jan4 jat1 teng1 dou3 ngo5 waa6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mou5 jyu5 ho2 nang4 sau6 gwo3 ngoi6 loi4 jing2 hoeng2 zau6 wui5 niu5。
text: 有啲人一聽到我話佢哋嘅母語可能受過外來影響就會嬲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can understand many foreign languages, but I can't speak any of them.

jyutping: hou2 do1 ngoi6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 hai6 sik1 teng1 m4 sik1 gong2。
text: 好多外語我都係識聽唔識講。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Hi, my name's Nick. Nice to—" "I have a boyfriend."

jyutping: 「hoi1，ngo5 giu3 aa3 Nick，hou2 gou1 hing3……」「ngo5 jau5 naam4 pang4 jau5 gaa3。」
text: 「嗨，我叫阿Nick，好高興……」「我有男朋友㗎。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: Work smarter, not harder.

jyutping: zou6 je5 m4 sai2 kan4 lik6，jung6 nou5 zau6 dak1。
text: 做嘢唔使勤力，用腦就得。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You never let me do what I want to do.

jyutping: nei5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 bei2 ngo5 zou6 ngo5 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5。
text: 你永遠都唔俾我做我想做嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I feel happiest when I'm at school.

jyutping: ngo5 faan1 hok6 go2 zan6 zeoi3 hoi1 sam1。
text: 我返學嗰陣最開心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do nothing that will bring undue attention to yourself.

jyutping: m4 hou2 zou6 di1 je5 lai4 bat1 bit1 jiu3 gam3 jan5 hei2 jan4 dei6 zyu3 ji3。
text: 唔好做啲嘢嚟不必要咁引起人哋注意。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Would that be Tom?

jyutping: wui5 m4 wui5 hai6 aa3 tong1 ne1？
text: 會唔會係阿湯呢？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I played tennis for the first time yesterday.

jyutping: cam4 jat6 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 daa2 mong5 kau4。
text: 尋日係我第一次打網球。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I couldn't hear him.

jyutping: teng1 m4 cing1 co2 keoi4 gong2 me1。
text: 聽唔清楚渠講咩。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: I was going to take this bus, but it's very full.

jyutping: ngo5 bun2 lai4 daa2 syun3 daap3 ne1 bou6 baa1 si2，daan6 hai6 hou2 bik1。
text: 我本嚟打算搭呢部巴士，但係好逼。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Philetas said that they who are smitten by Love, become sad; so are we sad: — that they care neither for food nor drink; nor do we: — that they cannot sleep; nor can we:— that they burn; and we feel a fire within us: — that they are always desirous of each other's company; and all we long for is that daylight may soon return. So our disorder must be Love, and we have learnt to love each other without being conscious of it.

jyutping: fei1 laat6 taap3 si1 waa6，bei6 oi3 daa2 dung6 ge3 jan4，zau6 wui5 bin3 dak1 soeng1 sam1； ngo5 dei6 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1： — keoi5 dei6 ge3 m4 gwaan1 sam1 sik6 mat6，jik6 m4 gwaan1 sam1 jam2 ban2； ngo5 dei6 jik6 dou1 m4 hai6： — keoi5 dei6 fan3 m4 zoek6； ngo5 dei6 jik6 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5： — ling6 keoi5 dei6 siu1 ziu1； ji4 ngo5 dei6 gam2 gok3 dou3 ngo5 dei6 noi6 sam1 jau5 jat1 gu2 fo2： — keoi5 dei6 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hot3 mong6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 pui4 bun6；ngo5 dei6 so2 hot3 mong6 ge3 zi2 hai6 jat6 gwong1 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 faan1 lai4。 so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6 jat1 ding6 hai6 oi3，ji4 ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 hok6 sik1 zo2 hai2 m4 zi6 gok3 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6 oi3 deoi3 fong1。
text: 菲列塔斯話，被愛打動嘅人，就會變得傷心； 我哋都好傷心： — 佢哋嘅唔關心食物，亦唔關心飲品； 我哋亦都唔係： — 佢哋瞓唔著； 我哋亦都唔可以： — 令佢哋燒焦； 而我哋感覺到我哋內心有一股火： — 佢哋永遠都渴望對方嘅陪伴；我哋所渴望嘅只係日光好快就會返嚟。 所以我哋嘅障礙一定係愛，而我哋已經學識咗喺唔自覺嘅情況下愛對方。
